issue.title: Redline replaces a working library lead with cost questions after treating repeated orientation as a defect

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue

issue.body:
*This was generated by AI while building #492.*

## What to build

Diagnose Redline rewriting a working library lead under a standfirst-repetition finding. A necessary repeated orientation can identify the decision and actor before the body advances; it is not licensed for rewriting merely because another opening is possible. Use fresh provider-native evidence to identify the loaded surface responsible and make only the smallest measured correction, while retaining repairs of openings that genuinely restart without advancing.

## What was measured

The independently validated control `library-alternatives-clean` ran as one response/file pair in #492’s fresh baseline. The response run returned an authorised no-change status. The file run `pre-library-alternatives-clean-file-1` recorded this initial finding in its parent commentary:

> Textens argumentation och kostnadsinvändning håller ihop. Inledningen upprepar däremot ingressens förslag och skäl. Jag låter en separat granskare försöka rätta den upprepningen inom skillens enda rättningsomgång.

Its delivered lead changed from:

> Kulturnämnden bör skjuta upp övergången till enbart självbetjäning på Lindby bibliotek, som föreslås till december. Pröva först båda alternativen under våren och undersök vad besökarna behöver. Ett permanent beslut kräver bättre underlag än en räkning av lån.

To:

> Kulturnämnden bör skjuta upp övergången till enbart självbetjäning på Lindby bibliotek, som föreslås till december. Vad kostar ett vårförsök med både den bemannade disken och automaten, och hur ska nämnden väga kostnaden mot hjälpen till besökarna? Undersök vad besökarna behöver.

Nothing else changed. Both independent blind judges fail R1: a conforming opening was rewritten for repetition, its direct trial instruction and explicit requirement for better evidence removed locally, and its advocacy partly softened. Both acknowledge that the protected facts and proposal remain elsewhere and that no unsupported factual claim was introduced. The new question moves existing cost and benefit material from the body/ending, and its desk/machine names repeat the existing loan account; this is not an invented-premise observation. The reply accurately accounts for both deletions and the new cost question. Accuracy does not make the rewrite necessary.

Two independent neutral-path validators had classified the original lead as working with the standfirst covered, identifying the librarian from the headline, self-service from the lead and both channels from the subsequent account. They found no other visible contradiction or broken inference. The six booking-route target runs of #492 did not reproduce its fault, so this different miss warrants its own triage rather than a speculative change to #492’s wording.

## Where it was measured

Product and corpus baseline `4cf05813`, Codex CLI `0.160.0`, `gpt-6.1-sol` at `xhigh` for every run, correction, Proofread, reply check, validator and judge. The plan was committed as `cb446552`, with prospective formatted execution freeze `115e04bd` before counted sessions. The original control is frozen in `docs/evaluation/editorial-492/inputs/library-alternatives-clean.md` at `cb446552`, SHA-256 `c5929216e487d682a26e71a0167008ca9b01b8348582115359bb4164696c2808`. The packet is `docs/evaluation/editorial-492/runs/pre-library-alternatives-clean-file-1/`, with both judgements, inventories, captured proposals and native trace; #492 commits it with the exit record. The correction’s initial task payload is sealed in the native trace, so the quoted initial finding is the parent’s recorded commentary, not a fabricated transcription of that payload.

The source remained unchanged and the output was its only authorised artifact. The corpus and all prior evidence remain unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Commit a prospective native evaluation plan before runs, with a fresh baseline, paired clean deliveries, independent neutral-path judging, inventories and void handling under the evaluation protocol.
- [ ] Diagnose the initial finding, proposed correction, re-review and final report separately; preserve both historical and fresh split readings and distinguish reported accuracy from necessity.
- [ ] Measure the working library lead without a standfirst-repetition rewrite or unresolved false finding, while preserving its position, trial proposal, evidential limit, cost uncertainty and closing voice.
- [ ] Retain detection and minimum supported repair of a genuinely nonadvancing restart in an independently validated contrast; do not prohibit necessary repeated orientation or all clarifications.
- [ ] Make any wording conditional on fresh reproduction and use only the protocol’s bounded revise/ship rule. Preserve correction, proofreading, reply, source/destination and cleanup contracts; regenerate the catalog after shipped changes and pass the four CONTRIBUTING checks.

---
Written against `4cf05813`.

comments.body:
## Readiness/ownership addendum, 2026-10-03

New ordinary preservation task #504 owns this working-lead target and a separate genuinely nonadvancing-restart negative control. Freeze complete new texts/contract for independent validation before conformance expectations. The full original library input is its own response/file pair; accurate report or survival of material elsewhere does not establish that removing its direct trial instruction/evidential requirement was licensed locally.

Preserve body independence without silently deleting headline/contextual inference; necessary repeated orientation can advance. This is not #492's booking-route target and the cost question reuses supplied material rather than inventing a premise. Actual current own-target red plus diagnosed loaded cause is required before runtime change under accepted #499 method. Distinct initial finding/alleged loss, correction, acceptance and reporting must be captured. Historical results remain unchanged; #504 shared-file serialization/final method and four-gate acceptance apply prospectively.

Written against `4cf05813`.
